hook.text: In 1960, the Trieste dove to the bottom of the Mariana Trench—and found a flatfish staring back.

buildup.text: Crewed submersibles like Alvin let scientists visit the deep ocean in person—but dives are expensive.

discovery.text: ROVs (remotely operated vehicles) explore with cameras and arms—no humans at risk.

twist.text: Modern AUVs (autonomous vehicles) can map the seafloor for days without any human control.

climax.text: Each generation of technology reveals species and features that rewrite ocean science.

punchline.text: Robots now dive where humans can't—and the discoveries keep coming.
